scope: Current unit and concurrency tests of memory/cache/swap libraries, including managed raster and RAW adapters; not universal format or GPU qualification
inspected_invariants: Combined byte/count/TTL tightening refuses atomically when visible pin and lease prevent eviction
Accepted new TTL applies to inserted/replaced entries; existing insertion deadlines remain unchanged
Expired visible allocation stays charged until unpinned and last owner drops
Disk byte/count/TTL and queue admission limits independently enforced
Idle swap TTL maintenance reclaims physical objects without foreground lookups
Repeated worker barriers do not starve TTL maintenance
limitations: Tests do not establish latency for every format
Existing TTL policy does not retroactively alter resident deadlines
